title: Taking Down Capwn
description: Taking Down Capwn — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Force Sissirat to drop the Safehouse Key, then track down Capwn and get his Books. Bring the Books back to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. And if Sissirat drops his staff, well, bring that, too.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Force Sissirat to drop the Safehouse Key, then track down Capwn and get his Books. Bring the Books back to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. And if Sissirat drops his staff, well, bring that, too.

Offer:

Great news Dungeon Runner! We have found out that Sissirat is hiding Ratphonze Capwn in a Secret Safehouse deep within Level 7 of Algernon. Capwn should have a copy of his Books on him and we need those as the last piece of proof that he is running the Squeakeasys.

It looks like Sissirat has the only key to the Safehouse door, so you will need to convince him to let you have it. With the key, find the Safehouse and get Capwn's Books from him. It doesn't really matter what happens to Capwn while you're there, we just want his Books to shutdown his Squeakeasy operation, make back our money and maybe bring Capwn to justice. Well, we will get around to that justice part. Some day. If we have some free time.

This brings me back to when the popular drink was called Just Ice. Back then, we had to use Prince Coins, you see and people had to prance to be able to use them. Everyone was called Prancing Princes (there were ten of them I think) and we used pizza cutters as weapons. I'm tired now.

Oh and Dungeon Runner, if Sissirat drops his staff while you are there, could you bring it back? No specific reason.

Turn-in:

Let me guess, another copy of Capwn's Books and Sissirat's Staff? How many of you Runners did I send down there? Well good job and all that, please take this as compliments of the house. I hope you enjoyed your stay, please come and visit us again. Check online for nightly rates, and make sure to check out the buffet.

Objectives:

  • Force Sissirat to Drop the Key
  • Sissirat's Dreamcatcher ×1
  • Find the Safehouse
  • Capwn's Books ×1

Level range: 13–20
